analysis.domain_lookalike: goog1esecurity-alert.com uses digit '1' instead of letter 'l' to mimic google
analysis.protocol: HTTP instead of HTTPS, no encryption on login form submission
analysis.form_embedding: HTML form embedded directly in email body for direct credential capture
analysis.final_destination: Phishing server collects submitted credentials and stores in plaintext

technical_data.waf_alert_log: [2023-04-19T14:06:10Z] ALERT: Suspicious POST to /verify with credential fields detected from IP 203.0.113.88. Rule ID 100001 Phishing Credential Harvesting.
technical_data.mfa_logs: [2023-04-19T14:06:15Z] User victim@example.com triggered MFA challenge due to unknown device login attempt; challenge failed.
indicators: Domain: goog1esecurity-alert.com (homoglyph using digit '1' instead of letter 'l')
Email sender IP: 203.0.113.77 (hosted on VPS with history of phishing campaigns)
Email passes SPF and DKIM for attacker domain but fails DMARC alignment with google.com
Embedded HTML form in email body rather than redirect link
HTTP protocol used for credential submission (not secure)
WAF detects credential POST and raises alerts
MFA logs show triggered challenge and failure indicating attempted unauthorized access
technical_data.detection_method: Leverage SPF/DKIM/DMARC email authentication with suspicious domain detection; identify embedded forms in emails via sandbox analysis; monitor web server logs and WAF for credential POST requests; correlate with MFA logs for suspicious second-factor failures; educate users on homoglyph domain risks and direct form phishing.
